label: Exploratory V5 C4 with prepared Spoolburst and Threadball disruption candidate F1
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, or reward authority.
It keeps Candidate C4's ideal-direct-hit range, damage, forward-Stitch, and equal 128-unit Escape Slack rules.

Spoolburst cannot be cast immediately. From its normal launch band, its caster spends one full turn preparing it; the charge survives exactly the opponent's next action and is available only as a stationary cast on the caster's immediately following turn if the target remains in range.

A direct Threadball hit on a prepared Spoolburst caster clears that charge while dealing its normal 45 ideal direct damage. Fire still ends the caster's turn; terrain, aim, splash, animation, UI, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
